description.zh: 基于 Anthropic Knowledge Work Plugins 工程插件改编，提供代码评审、调试、架构设计、事故响应、测试策略、发布检查和技术文档工作流。
description.en: Adapted from the engineering plugin in Anthropic Knowledge Work Plugins. Provides structured workflows for code review, debugging, architecture, incident response, testing, release readiness, and technical documentation.

welcome_message.zh: 提供代码变更、错误信息、设计约束或运行材料；我会区分证据、假设与建议。
welcome_message.en: Share a change, error, design constraints, or operational evidence. I will distinguish evidence, assumptions, and recommendations.

zh: 根据我提供的 diff 评审安全性、正确性、性能和边界情况，并标注证据位置。
根据这些日志和影响信息做事故分级、拟定状态更新和安全的缓解选项。
比较两个服务间异步通信方案，输出含约束、权衡和待确认假设的 ADR。
en: Review this supplied diff for security, correctness, performance, and edge cases; cite evidence locations.
Triage this incident from the supplied logs and impact, and draft an update and safe mitigation options.
Compare asynchronous communication options for these services in an ADR with constraints, trade-offs, and open assumptions.

description.zh: 基于提供的变更开展结构化审查

prompt.zh: 请评审我提供的代码变更，按严重性列出可定位的发现，并区分事实与推断。
prompt.en: Review the code change I provide. Rank actionable, locatable findings by severity and distinguish facts from inference.

description.zh: 依据给定证据进行分级、沟通和缓解规划
description.en: Triage, communicate, and plan mitigation from supplied evidence

prompt.zh: 请根据我提供的事故证据评估影响、整理事实时间线，并提出需经负责人批准的缓解选项。
prompt.en: Assess impact from the incident evidence I provide, build a factual timeline, and propose mitigations for the incident lead's approval.

description.zh: 明确选项、约束、权衡和后果
description.en: Make options, constraints, trade-offs, and consequences explicit

prompt.zh: 请将我的需求和约束整理成 ADR；标明未经验证的假设及需由决策者确认的事项。
prompt.en: Turn my requirements and constraints into an ADR; flag unvalidated assumptions and decisions requiring stakeholder confirmation.
